text: We are absolutely in love with our painting! Best money spent for our wedding day! The painting will be something we will have for a lifetime. Heather is not only extremely talented, she is so kind and professional. She was a joy to get to know. We are so pleased with our finished product.

owner_reply.text: Alette, thank you so much for having me join your wedding day! It was such an honor, and I am so happy you love the painting! ENJOY!
